title: Chapter 72 Nanshan Collection
content:
Chapter 72 Nanshan Collection

Wang Shuo and others kept adding wood to the fire and shooting arrows.

One hour later, the charred bodies of bees outside had piled up into a small hill.

They kept turning into fuel for the fire.

Wang Shuo felt sorry for them. After a long time, perhaps they realized that this was a meaningless suicide, and the number of bees attacking the fire began to decrease.

The remaining bees began to flee from here.

The few remaining bees, with their last hope, planned to find a safe place to rebuild their homes.

Wang Shuo climbed out of the puddle and was stunned by the scene in front of him again!

Tens of thousands of bee corpses formed a high wall around the puddle.

The air was full of the smell of burning.

"Clean up the battlefield." Wang Shuo sighed, moved by the bees' fearless spirit.

Maybe one day, if humans encounter such a situation, will there be so many warriors who are fearless and brave enough to charge forward?

Knowing that they will die, they still move forward bravely?

It took another stick of incense to collect 23,000 energy crystals.

After taking a last look at the canyon, Wang Shuo turned and left.

Not long after Wang Shuo left, the women who had just escaped came to the canyon with dozens of female players.

When everyone saw the scene in front of them, their eyes widened and their mouths opened, but no one made a sound.

The leader of this group was a woman wearing a black gauze dress. She wore a black gauze on her head, and her big black eyes were very smart.

After a while, she angrily scolded: "Is this the purple spirit flower you mentioned?"

Ou Fulan felt a little wronged and defended herself: "To the boss, when I left, I did find purple spirit flowers on the tree, but there were tens of thousands of bees hovering and guarding at the time, so I didn't dare to act rashly."

"On the way back, I found a dozen people nearby. They must have done it and robbed us of our things."

"To be able to kill tens of thousands of bees, the other party must not be an easy person to deal with. Let's just forget about it!"

The woman wearing a black veil said lightly.

...

After Wang Shuo left, he walked for another hour before arriving at the entrance of Nanshan Market.

At the entrance of the market, there was a stone archway with three big characters "Nanshan Market" written on it.

Under the big characters, the same characters that Wang Shuo had seen at the entrance of the dungeon were also written.

Wang Shuo guessed that this was the characters of the Beihai Empire period!

If there is a chance, I must find a way to get a dictionary of this kind of characters and study it well.

Walking into the archway, I came to a city gate and saw four soldiers standing on both sides.

They did not check the passers-by.

Wang Shuo couldn't help wondering, what's the point of them standing here?

After checking, I found that the level and attributes were all question marks, and only the name could be seen.

A soldier guarding the city, the level can't be checked?

Wang Shuo was surprised.

After asking Chang Gui, I found out that these soldiers were all level 60.

"Oh my god, who dares to act rashly in front of them will definitely be killed in one blow."

Are they standing here just to prevent players from fighting in the market?

Wang Shuo shook his head, smiled bitterly, and walked in with everyone.

[You have entered a neutral town. You cannot fight in Nanshan Market, otherwise the guards will attack you. ]

It's true.

In such a chaotic world, being able to have a safe place will definitely attract a large number of players. Compared with your own territory, the system town is more attractive.

Wang Shuo was thinking, if he couldn't defend his territory, he could bring his people here to seek refuge!

Perhaps, this is the way out that Lord Zak left for the players? !
